llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure header options from screen logic using `useLayoutEffect` (for example to set `headerRight`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useLayoutEffect is called with navigation.setOptions({ headerRight: ... }) and re-runs when bookmarked or navigation changes.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Header action wired in `headerRight` must update component state, and that updated state must be reflected in screen UI.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The headerRight Pressable calls toggleBookmark which updates the bookmarked state via setBookmarked; the screen body renders 'Bookmarked' or 'Not bookmarked' conditionally on that state.
